events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8960 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t235-run/probe.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t235-run/probe.log; grep -c "^FAIL" /tmp/t235-run/probe.log; grep "^FAIL" /tmp/t235-run/probe.log | head -10; grep -i "replay\|nudge\|no-show\|threshold\|second run" /tmp/t235-run/probe.log | cut -c1-220 | head -30; tail -2 /tmp/t235-run/probe.log | cut -c1-200
